name: Varbase Social Single Sign-On
description: Varbase feature that wires the Social Auth provider ecosystem (Google, Facebook, LinkedIn and others) into a site and places a social-login block on the login and register pages.
project_description: Varbase Social Single Sign-On adds single sign-on to a Drupal site using an existing identity on a social networking service such as Google, Facebook, or LinkedIn. It is a thin Varbase feature built on the Social API / Social Auth ecosystem: it declares the provider modules as Composer dependencies, runs an install recipe that enables Social Auth Google, and ships an optional social-login block that appears on the login and register pages. It can be installed on any Drupal site (Minimal or Standard profile), but is designed for and best used with the Varbase distribution. Sponsored and developed by Vardot.
